_comment: Central app-name translations for the M365 Copilot Usage Reporter. Deployed instances fetch this file periodically and merge it OVER their built-in defaults, so renames/new surfaces/exclusions can be rolled out without redeploying. Keys are the prefix-stripped Graph appClass, lowercased. 'app_names' maps a raw appClass to a friendly display name; 'excluded_apps' lists appClasses that are system-generated or not genuine human usage and must be dropped at ingest.
